summary: On paper New England has the edge (New England ranks 3rd in EPA per dropback, +0.24), while Green Bay's best counter is to wrap up (Green Bay's defense ranks 11th in broken tackles per touch, 10.9% missed). Under center, Drake Maye ranks 5th of 30 in EPA per dropback and Jordan Love ranks 8th; x-factor: Matthew Golden gets 28% of Green Bay's targets and 40% of its air yards, and New England's pass defense ranks 12th. The model favors New England at 64%, mostly on rushing matchup (1.9 pts) and home field (1.7 pts).
